comments.author: @Noone-mo4dr
comments.text:
I don't know, I am of the mindset that GPT is not the holy grail of AI that they want people to think it is.  Anyone who has tinkered around with local decoder only generative models could tell you there are inherent limits to how the architecture works.  It is simply just predicting the next statistically likely token based on distributions of likely words/tokens.  It can't "think".

You should really watch the lecture "How large language models work (and why that's why they don't)"
